## What it makes

Two lip-sync paths: one synchronizes your video to external speech, the other uses the video's original audio. Each has its own LAS node and video save. These modes skip standard translation and text-to-speech, so they do not provide translated captions. Use footage and audio you are authorized to process.

## The workflow

<Shot src="templates/las-lip-sync-workflow.webp" alt="LAS Lip Sync workflow with external-audio and source-audio LAS branches and separate video saves" caption="Two LAS nodes show external speech and source-audio lip sync separately." />

1. Read the **MarkdownNote**. **Load Video** supplies the source and **Load Audio** supplies one external speech clip.
2. The first **[LAS Video Translation](../../nodes/las-video-translation/)** node uses `lip_sync_external_audio`; the second uses `lip_sync_source_audio`.
3. Two **Save Video** nodes keep the branch results separately. Preserve each accepted `task_id` for interrupted collection.

## Run it

1. Save your LAS API key in **Settings > BytePlus** ([API keys](../../get-started/api-keys/)).
2. Open **LAS Lip Sync**, choose your source video and fill your writable Johor `output_tos_path` on each branch you will run.
3. Choose one external clip in **Load Audio** for the external branch. To use `dubbing_audio_url` instead, disconnect `dubbing_audio`.
4. Set `audio_language` on the source-audio branch. The source video must have an audio track. To run only one branch, mute the unused LAS node and its save node before queueing.
5. Log in to Comfy.org for connected-media uploads, then press **Run**. Inspect lip motion and timing in each saved video.

## Settings worth changing

- **`mode`:** external and source audio are alternatives. Switching modes changes the available inputs.
- **`dubbing_language`:** in external mode, select the speech language or `auto` for service detection.
- **`ignore_audio_video_duration_mismatch`:** leave off for matched media. The override may loop or trim video and affect billing.
- **`dubbing_audio_url`:** use a persistent public or authorized TOS reference instead of connected audio when appropriate.
- **Source duration and frame rate:** lip sync is limited to 10 minutes and 30 fps. Connected external audio normally must match within one second.

## Example result

No example output is published here. Inspect your own result for visible lip alignment, timing and any unintended trimming. Do not infer caption or clean-audio availability from a successful video result.

## Time and cost

Each active branch submits its own task and bills on your LAS account. Upload size, source duration and collection affect waiting time. These specified-audio modes cannot be combined with restoration or a separate subtitle picture source. Interrupting ComfyUI does not cancel remote work; recover each accepted task instead of submitting another one to retry collection.
